messages.author: 67573fb6b406e2fa
messages.subject: TMB binary to RTMB
parts:
A few months ago in another thread it was mentioned that the TMB binary can be made compatible to the RTMB::getTape. I was wondering what options to set in
TMB::compile so the binary will be compatible with RTMB. I have tried a few things on my computer (windows) but in vain.

Thanks for the help.

Happy new year.

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: TMB binary to RTMB
parts:
RTMB::GetTape (currently) works for a cpp file compiled with:

TMB::compile("file.cpp", framework="TMBad", CPPFLAGS="-DTMBAD_INDEX_TYPE=uint64_t", openmp=FALSE)

which may be verified by running the following test:

TMB::runExample("ar1xar1", framework="TMBad", CPPFLAGS="-DTMBAD_INDEX_TYPE=uint64_t", openmp=FALSE)
F <- RTMB::GetTape(obj)
